arabic_html:
ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ
لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ
وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۞
translation: He who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: Allah brought life and death into being to test which of us is best in deed — the verse says best, not most. The measure is quality, not quantity.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathir: Allah brought life and death into being to test which of us is best in deed — the verse says best, not most. The measure is quality, not quantity.
